# @zakkster/lite-hud v2.2.0

Zero-GC SPP-native canvas overlay for the @zakkster profiler suite.
Single-file ESM (Hud.js). No runtime dependencies. MIT.
Optional peer: @zakkster/lite-viewport (injected as a CLASS; inline DPR fallback otherwise).
Optional peer: @zakkster/lite-sketch (inject a `() => DDSketch` factory for percentiles).

## Model

- **Sink.** `hud` is a duck-typed SPP sink: `{ write(packed, t, a, b) }`.
- **attach(scope).** Reads `scope.streams()` descriptors, builds LUT and per-channel Float64Array rings, calls `scope.addSink(hud_self)`.
- **write(packed, t, a, b).** Hot path. Decodes `sid = (packed/65536)|0`, `op = (packed - sid*65536)|0` using arithmetic (not bitwise, to avoid Int32 sign extension for sid >= 0x8000). Routes via `lut[sid][op & 0xFF]`.

## Protocol constants (inlined)

```
META_STREAM = 0     OP_EPOCH = 0x0F00   OP_CONT = 0x0F01
OP_VERDICT  = 0x0F40   OP_BUDGET_SET = 0x0F41
KIND_LEVEL=0  KIND_INSTANT=1  KIND_SPAN=2  KIND_COUNTER=3
```

## Ring layout

Stride = `3 * width` per record: `[t, a, b]` for width=1.
For CONT: `[t,a,b, c0,c1,c2]` (width=2) or `[t,a,b,c0,c1,c2,d0,d1,d2]` (width=3).
Capacity = `pow2(ceil(hz * windowSec) + 1)` for LEVEL, else 256.
Head advances in record units; bitmask = `cap - 1`.

## Paired SPAN layout

Ring record: `[t_open, t_close, correlId]`.
Open pool: an inline integer-keyed open-addressing map per paired channel
(Float64Array correlId + t_open, Uint8Array occupancy so id 0 is legal, linear
probe + backshift delete, slots = pow2 >= 2*cap). Allocated at attach (cold);
zero-alloc on open/close. Oldest-first eviction when full via a Float64Array FIFO
of open keys with a per-slot sequence for lazy skip (drops++). NaN correlId on
open = a counted drop; `-0` normalizes to `+0`; re-open of an open key overwrites
t_open and keeps its FIFO position (Map.set semantics).

## Complete SPAN layout (D5)

Ring record: `[t_start, duration_ms, 0]`.
Manual `push(durationMs)` synthesizes: `write(packed, now - dur, dur, 0)`.

## BUDGET_SET (0x0F41)

`a = interned_channel_name_id`, `b = threshold_value`.
HUD resolves via `scope.label(a|0)` -> channel name match.
A repeat BUDGET_SET for a channel REPLACES its threshold in a preallocated
per-channel slot -- no object allocated per record, no unbounded append.
DI alternative (cold, at attach): `hud.attach(scope, { budgets: [{channel, threshold, label?}] })`.
Both kinds render as dashed threshold lines.

## Quantile analytics (M2) -- optional PEER via injection

Inject a `() => DDSketch` factory (lite-sketch >= 1.1.0); the HUD never imports it.

```
createHud(el, { stats: { quantiles: () => new DDSketch(0.01) } });
hud.channel({ name, kind, quantiles });  // per-channel: a factory (opt IN), or false (opt OUT)
```

- What is sketched: complete + paired SPAN durations ALWAYS when a factory is
  injected; LEVEL opt-in (per-channel `quantiles` factory, or a scope op with
  `quantiles: true`); COUNTER / INSTANT never.
- Zero-box hot path: the value is stored into a per-channel `Float64Array(1)` in
  write()'s frame and fed to the peer via `addFrom(buf, 0)` (read UNBOXED inside
  the peer), so a fractional value never boxes at the call boundary. Requires
  lite-sketch >= 1.1.0; a factory missing `addFrom` fails closed.
- Pre-check law (peer no-throw): the hot path rejects exactly what addFrom would
  throw on -- NaN / negative / +-Infinity, and `v>0` outside the accepted band
  `minIndexable < v <= maxIndexable` (EXCLUSIVE low, INCLUSIVE high) -- counts a
  `stats().quantileDrops`, and NEVER lets addFrom throw into write(). No try/catch
  on the hot path. `v === 0` is legal; `-0` sums as 0.
- Bounds + strict come from the sketch GETTERS (`strict`, `minIndexable`,
  `maxIndexable`) read ONCE, cold, at channel-sketch creation (no probe). A
  STRICT-range DDSketch (`{ range }`, `strict === true`), a missing `addFrom`, or
  non-finite indexable getters throw `@zakkster/lite-hud:` fail-closed -- inject a
  default collapsing sketch.
- Window: two sketches A/B rotated every windowSec/2 by record time (O(1) on the
  hot path; the retiring one is clear()ed); render/inspect clear() a scratch and
  merge() A+B into it, then quantile(). merge/clear are 0-alloc.
- Readout: p50 / p90 / p99 / p99.9 + N tiles per sketched channel + a shaded
  p50-p99 band behind LEVEL traces. An empty window shows "--", never 0.
- Memory: 3 x maxBins x 8 B per sketched channel (48 KB at 2048 bins).
- Read from code: `hud.inspect(name).quantiles` -> `{ p50, p90, p99, p999, n }`
  (present only when the channel is sketched; `n:0` + NaN on an empty window).

## Manual channels (D4)

`hud.channel({ name?, unit?, hz?, kind? })` -> `{ push(v) }`.
Synthetic stream IDs start at `0x8000` (arithmetic packed: `sid*65536 + opLow`).
`push()` calls `write()` directly. One rendering truth.

## API

```js
import { createHud, VERSION } from '@zakkster/lite-hud';
const hud = createHud(mountEl, { windowSec, position, hotkey, zIndex, viewport, maxDpr, stats });
hud.attach(scope, { budgets? });  // scope-driven channels
const fps = hud.channel({ name: 'fps', kind: 0 }); fps.push(60); // manual
hud.write(packed, t, a, b);       // direct SPP sink
hud.stats();                      // { drops, channels, epoch, verdicts, budgets, quantileDrops, channelStats }
hud.inspect(name);                // { count, last: {t,a,b}, quantiles? } | null (cold path)
hud.render();                     // draw at ~10-15Hz
hud.show(); hud.hide(); hud.destroy();
hud.visible; // getter
```

## Attach-time validation

- Throws on `op.code & 0xFF` collision within a single stream (SPP invariant).
  Cross-stream reuse of the same low byte is fine.
- CONT slots buffer is `Float64Array(3 * maxWidth)` per stream; any width
  supported. Buffer grows if a later op needs more slots.

## Rendering (viewport / maxDpr)

- `viewport`: a Viewport CLASS (typeof 'function', else throws with the
  `@zakkster/lite-hud:` prefix). Injected -> the HUD owns a sized wrapper `<div>`
  (positioning moves to it, canvas inside) so the viewport measures the HUD, not
  the page; `new viewport({ canvas, maxDpr, onResize })`; uses `vp.ctx` / `vp.dpr`;
  row growth sets wrapper height + calls `vp.resize()` synchronously; `destroy()`
  calls `vp.destroy()` and removes the wrapper.
- `maxDpr`: finite number >= 1, or Infinity (default, no cap); else throws. Caps
  devicePixelRatio for the backing store. Fallback path (no viewport) keeps the
  inline DOM + `setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0)` before `scale(dpr,dpr)` (no cumulative
  scaling) + the maxDpr cap.

## Zero-GC (witnessed)

- Zero LIBRARY-OWNED allocation: `write()` (every record kind), paired open+close,
  pool eviction churn, meta records, AND the analytics-ON write path (LEVEL /
  complete SPAN / paired via addFrom) are 0 B/op: `node --expose-gc test/torture.mjs`
  (lite-leak + lite-gc-profiler; retained lane, fractional analytics lanes, scavenge
  lanes) + `test/perf/` (lite-perf-gate: PerfGate.test.mjs integer scenarios at 0
  scavenges + AnalyticsBox.test.mjs fractional ON==OFF delta yardstick + controls).
- Caveat: a DISTINCT fractional double passed as an argument is boxed by V8 at the
  JS call boundary (~16 B transient, never retained), like any JS function taking a
  double; storing a fractional magnitude into the ring costs nothing (a reused
  constant is witnessed at 0). channel().push() reads wall-clock time, so it is
  gated on the RETAINED lane (torture, 0 B/op), not the scavenge lane.
- Render is a disclosed COLD path (caller-throttled ~10-15 Hz) and may allocate.

## Conventions

- ASCII-only source. No console.log/debugger in shipped code.
- `node:test` suite (112 tests). Run: `node --test test/Hud.test.js` or `npm test`.
- Gates: `npm run torture` / `torture:controls` / `test:perf` / `verify`.
- sideEffects: false. MIT. Copyright Zahary Shinikchiev.
